recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, low-angle urban portrait featuring two figures in dark hoodies against a weathered industrial backdrop, framed by bold, architectural block lettering at the top and condensed sans-serif text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Heavy top-weighted typography balancing the dark mass of the figures below
Warm orange and red tones in the header contrasting with the cool, dark shadows of the subjects
Low-angle perspective creating a sense of dominance and scale for the central figures
Industrial textures of brick and rusted metal providing a tactile backdrop for clean graphic elements
coreInvariants: Heavy horizontal bars integrated into the top typography
Gritty, high-contrast lighting on the subjects
Warm-to-cool color gradient from top to bottom

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central figures in dark clothing occupy the middle and lower thirds of the frame, shot from a low perspective to appear larger than life.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive, blocky header text spanning the entire width of the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large orange header, move down through the dark silhouettes of the figures, and settle on the bright yellow subtitle at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with texture, figures, and large-scale type.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the subjects and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Burnt orange and brick red in the header and background textures.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale yellow for the bottom subtitle and white/yellow graffiti highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark, desaturated figures and the vibrant, saturated header elements.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a warm, earthy industrial palette

letterConstructionRules: Integration of thick horizontal bars above and below the letterforms
Uniform stroke weight throughout the glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are sliced by horizontal bars that act as both decorative elements and structural baselines/meanlines

composition.relationshipToImage: frames the top of the scene
anchors the base of the composition

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast: ultra-wide display type paired with ultra-condensed subtitle type.

candidateDirections.reason: Base skeleton for the wide top text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photograph of two men in dark hooded sweatshirts standing in front of a rusted, graffiti-covered industrial wall. The lighting is dramatic with deep shadows. The overall tone is gritty and urban with a warm color cast in the upper half.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a massive, ultra-wide geometric display title across the top, featuring thick horizontal bars above and below the letters. Add a bold, condensed sans-serif subtitle centered at the very bottom in pale yellow.

verificationChecks: Is the top text ultra-wide and integrated with bars?
Is the camera angle sufficiently low?
Is the color palette dominated by dark tones and warm accents?
Is the bottom text condensed and legible?

adjustableVariables: Width of the top display text
Degree of the low-angle camera tilt
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Exact graffiti tags in the background

mustAchieve: Sense of urban weight and presence

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the top bars do not obscure the legibility of the display text
Check that the figures remain the focal point despite the heavy type
Verify the color transition from the warm top to the dark bottom
Confirm the low-angle perspective is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Low-Angle Urban Portrait] + [Ultra-Wide Barred Header] + [Condensed Bottom Subtitle] + [Industrial Warm/Dark Palette]
